usedFor: Qminder runs your visitor queue, and Google Drive prepares files for each visitor with “Copy a File”.

bestTemplate.name: “visitor checks in” in Qminder, then “Copy a File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A check-in is when a visitor needs paperwork, so a template copy is ready as they sit down.

watchOut: “Share File” grants Viewer, Commenter or Editor access, so check which person and level before you share a visitor's file.
